description: Signed agent passport: a signature over domain "atlas-pca/passport-sig/v1\0" || canonical JSON of every field except sig/pq_sig. Native verifiers reproduce `expect.ok` and `expect.reason` (reason text beyond the code is not part of the contract). Check order: shape, version, suite, issuer, signature, id, validity window, subject, revocation, hardware evidence (presence, age, verifier, binding, identity). A vector with `signed_ref` reuses the document of the named vector. `pqPins` pins the PQ key of the issuer; a non-Ed25519 suite verifies only under it. A verifier that does not implement the suite of a vector must answer `unsupported_suite` instead of `expect`. A vector with `hardware` stands in for a vendor verifier: the stub answers {ok, bound, measured} (or throws) and must be handed `expectBinding`; verifiers without a stub seam answer `hardware_verifier_missing`.
